name: Monthly Asset Disposal List
query:
select b.parent 'Bulk Disposal', b.asset Asset, a.journal_entry_for_scrap 'Scrap Journal Entry', a.status 'Status', a.gross_purchase_amount 'Gross Purchase Amount',
    a.asset_category 'Category', d.income_depreciation_amount 'Income Dep Amount'
from `tabBulk Asset Disposal Item` b join tabAsset a on a.name=b.asset 
left join `tabDepreciation Schedule` d on d.parent=a.name and d.schedule_date between %(from_date)s and %(to_date)s
where b.parent in (
    select name 
    from `tabBulk Asset Disposal` 
    where scrap_date between %(from_date)s and %(to_date)s
) order by a.asset_category, b.asset;
